title: The Retro: Pool | Hot Tub | Basketball | Games
description:
This 5-bedroom home is jam-packed with amenities & has EVERYTHING you need for an amazing vacation in Mesa, AZ!

• 2 miles away to Downtown Mesa
• 7 miles away to Chandler Mall
• Private Pool
• Basketball Court
• Hot Tub
• Outdoor Patio/Dining
• BBQ Grill
• Indoor Games: Darts, Arcade Games, Foosball, Ping Pong & Pool Table!
• Fully Stocked Kitchen
• Indoor Fireplace - Not For Guest Use
• Dedicated Workspace
• Family & Dog Friendly

 The space 
Desert Escape Awaits in Mesa!

Welcome to this spacious two-story retreat designed for fun, relaxation, and unforgettable gatherings. With 5 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this stunning home comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests, making it ideal for family get-togethers, golf trips, bachelor/bachelorette celebrations, or simply a rejuvenating getaway.

Inside, you’ll find a thoughtfully designed space that blends comfort and entertainment. The full game room offers hours of entertainment with skee-ball, ping pong, darts, and arcade games. Outside, the backyard oasis is built for both play and leisure—dive into the pool, unwind in the hot tub, or shoot hoops at the basketball court.

This home is professionally managed by a premier local hospitality company, ensuring every detail is cared for at the highest level. From meticulous cleaning to thoughtful touches throughout, we take pride in creating a memorable guest experience.

 Guest access 
The guest has access to the entire home minus the locked cleaners' closet.

 Other things to note 
STR Permit #LIC23-08297 City of Mesa

Check-in is at 4pm
Check-out is at 10am

- Up to 2 dogs are allowed for $125 per stay, no cats please. We kindly ask that your dog is crate trained and that you pick up after your dog.
- No parties allowed—violations may result in immediate termination of the stay. We aim to maintain a respectful environment for our neighbors.
- An exterior camera is installed solely to monitor our cleaning team for quality and security purposes.
- Parking is available for 4 vehicles in the driveway & garage. Please note that street parking is allowed.
- If you're interested in a long-term stay, please reach out to inquire about availability. 
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this property. 

GUEST VERIFICATION:
To help ensure a smooth and secure stay for all guests, the primary guest listed on the reservation may be asked to complete a quick verification process within 48 hours of booking, depending on the platform used to book the reservation.

Prior to check-in, guests may also be asked to sign a Rental Agreement that includes agreeing to our rental terms and conditions and, on certain booking platforms, providing a valid government-issued ID and matching credit card before arrival.

Included with your booking is our damage waiver coverage, which helps protect against accidental, self-reported damage during your stay when reported prior to check-out.
